problems.name: Bilateral degenerative arthritis of the knees

procedures.name: Right total knee arthroplasty
procedures.outcome: tolerated the procedure well and there were no complications

course.narrative: A 69-year-old male with bilateral knee pain and degenerative arthritis presented for surgery. He underwent a right total knee arthroplasty under general anesthesia, performed in conjunction with a left total knee arthroplasty. Zimmer NexGen components were utilized. Estimated blood loss for the bilateral procedure was 400 cc with a total tourniquet time of 75 minutes. The procedure was completed without complications. The wound was closed with sutures and staples, a drain with ConstaVac was placed, and sterile dressings were applied. The patient tolerated the procedure well and was transferred to the Postanesthesia Care Unit.
